exposure: Invasive prenatal diagnostic procedures (chorionic villus sampling, amniocentesis)
cohort: The study included 449,012 women who gave birth from 2016 to 2018 and were residents of eight specific Italian regions.
finding: The overall prevalence of antibiotic use in Italy was 33.9% pre-pregnancy, 31.8% during pregnancy, and 29.3% post-pregnancy, with significant regional variations and peaks observed in line with invasive prenatal diagnostic procedures.
followup_time: Antibiotic use was observed up to three trimesters post-pregnancy (approximately 9 months after birth).
